title: An eduspeak translation guide around #diversity #disrupttexts #edu307 #edu506

body_html:
diverse schools-> segregated schools with black and brown children
good schools-> school filled with white kids
award winning schools-> school filled with rich white children
celebrate diversity -> a day where you eat ethnic food in white schools.
low SES-> schools with black and brown children, sometimes rural poor, but usually forgotten
High FRL->schools with black and brown children
Diverse Text- picking a book with a black or brown character, but usually in a far off land to avoid uncomfortable conversations of racism
